title: Taylor polynomials and where they fail
lede: A function (teal) and its Taylor polynomial at 0 (gold) of the degree you choose. The red band is the gap between them.
notice: For sin x and eˣ the band narrows everywhere as the degree grows, and the max error falls toward zero.
For 1/(1 + x²) and ln(1 + x) the polynomials hug the function inside |x| < 1, but beyond |x| = 1 they swing away faster as the degree rises.
The limit is the radius of convergence. For 1/(1 + x²) it is 1 even though the function is smooth for every real x.
hint: Pick a function, then raise the degree n and watch the band.
